exercises.question: Which sentence gives a position?
options: No creo que sea la mejor opción, aunque entiendo el argumento. [I don't think it is the best option, although I understand the argument.]
Hay diferentes opciones en la lista de la reunión. [There are different options on the meeting list.]
La opción de la reunión está en la lista de tareas. [The meeting option is on the task list.]

exercises.sentence: Estoy convencido de que debemos ___ porque el problema es importante.
exercises.english: I am convinced that we should act because the problem is important.
I don't think it is the best option.

sentences: Primero, escucho el argumento de mi compañero. [First, I listen to my colleague's argument.]
Después, explico por qué no estoy de acuerdo. [Then I explain why I disagree.]
Finalmente, concluyo: «No creo que sea la mejor opción». [Finally, I conclude: “I don't think it is the best option.”]

exercises.question: Which verb means «to justify»?
options: justificar [to justify]
superar [to overcome]
cambiar [to change]

exercises.english: We have to justify this decision.
It is important that we listen to different opinions.

exercises.sentence: No creo que sea la mejor opción.
options: I don't think it is the best option.
I am sure it is the best option.
I chose the best option.

exercises.sentence: Estoy convencido de que debemos actuar.
options: I am convinced that we should act.
I doubt that we should act.
I asked whether we should act.

exercises.sentence: Entiendo el argumento, aunque no creo que sea suficiente.
exercises.english: I understand the argument, although I don't think it is enough.

template.prompt: Say that you do not think this is the best solution, although you understand the problem.
template.answer: No creo que esta sea la mejor solución, aunque entiendo el problema.

template.prompt: Say that you are convinced that we must act because the problem is important for many people.
template.answer: Estoy convencido de que debemos actuar porque el problema es importante para muchas personas.

template.prompt: Say that you understand this argument, but you do not think it is enough.
template.answer: Entiendo este argumento, pero no creo que sea suficiente.
